keyframe_assets.prompt: Create a photorealistic vertical UGC-style keyframe of the uploaded brunette female model in a crowded sunny soccer stadium before using the product. She is wearing a fitted black T-shirt, looks hot and uncomfortable, slightly sweaty, and is reacting to the harsh sun. Keep her facial identity close to the uploaded model, preserve a realistic game-day environment, and frame her in a medium close-up with the stadium crowd behind her. No hat yet. No text, no graphics, no studio lighting.
notes: emotion should echo the reference pain-point shot
environment must stay public and crowded
this frame becomes the opening motion anchor

keyframe_assets.prompt: Create a photorealistic vertical first-person UGC keyframe in a packed sunny soccer stadium. Two foreground hands hold up a beige wide-brim solar fan hat toward the uploaded brunette female model, who is seated in the stands and reacting with interest and relief. The hat must match the product references: beige brim, black side-mounted fans, visible solar panels. Keep the environment continuous with the stadium setting and make the product dominate the foreground. No text or e-commerce graphics.
notes: this is the clone equivalent of the rescue reveal
foreground product scale matters more than full-body composition
woman should still look slightly overheated here

keyframe_assets.prompt: Create a photorealistic vertical close-up keyframe of the uploaded brunette female model wearing the beige solar fan hat in a sunny crowded soccer stadium. She is in the middle of adjusting the hat or turning the fan on. The hat must stay extremely faithful to the product references: beige wide brim, black dual fans mounted at the sides, small solar panels near the fan housings, realistic outdoor hat proportions. Keep the woman’s face close to the uploaded model and make the shot feel like a handheld UGC product demo, not a catalog shot.
notes: this is the hardest product-accuracy frame
must preserve fan placement and believable hat geometry
used as the anchor for the hero motion shot

keyframe_assets.prompt: Create a photorealistic vertical UGC-style hero keyframe of the uploaded brunette female model in a packed sunny soccer stadium wearing the beige solar fan hat. She now looks relieved, happy, and comfortable, and lightly points toward one of the built-in black fans as if recommending the product. Preserve her facial identity, black T-shirt, and the realistic stadium background. The frame should feel like the natural successful ending of the same moment sequence, not a sales poster. No text overlay.
notes: this replaces the weak free-form CTA approach
should feel like the exact emotional reversal of KF1
this frame should be strong enough to work as final thumbnail too
